config.script:
# 1.2.0: RESET ALL IGs for the area on screen in one press - booth.safetyreset holds the area's HMI reset 3.5 s
	# (clears a safety fault), waits out the PLC's fault-reset pulse, then taps it 0.2 s (resets the groups).
	# It runs on the gateway, refuses a second press while one is running, and writes the HMI alarm history.
	booth.safetyreset.press(self.view.custom.area, self.session.props.auth.user.userName,
		'Safety Diagnostics popup %s' % self.page.props.path)
self.view.custom.ig = ''
self.view.custom.onlyBad = not self.view.custom.onlyBad

# 1.3.0: the area map in place of the device list; kept for the session
	on = not bool(self.view.custom.showMap)
	self.view.custom.showMap = on
	try:
		self.session.custom.safetyDiagMap = on
	except:
		pass

tooltip.text: The area map: live safety devices and the isolation groups - tap a group to pick it

config.expression: if(len(coalesce({view.custom.ig}, '')) > 0, 'Map - ' + {view.custom.area} + ' ' + replace({view.custom.ig}, {view.custom.area} + '_', '') + ' picked - tap it again or outside the outlines for every group; Map off for its device list', 'Map - live safety devices (gates GS, E-stops ES, pull cords PR, isolators IS, standstill SS) and the isolation groups - tap a group to pick it')
